name: Microsoft Azure
summary:
Microsoft Azure’s site is azure.microsoft.com. The blue “A” is not the four-square Microsoft logo from microsoft.com unless this host’s response actually was that file.

Checked 12 November 2026 against azure.microsoft.com. The homepage request ended as timeout, so discovery continued with icon paths. No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

The favicon.ico URL is https://azure.microsoft.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 17174 bytes. Directory sizes: 128×128, 72×72, 48×48, 32×32, 24×24, 16×16.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

The only measured sizes are inside favicon.ico: 128×128, 72×72, 48×48, 32×32, 24×24, 16×16.
